scope: Q3Test curve facets: the winding each release cuts them from and the bounds it reads, against every release's retail executable
platform: Windows 11, x86; clang (i686-pc-windows-msvc) harness; MSVC x86 dedicated servers on a private desktop

rule.code: code/qcommon/cm_patch.c CM_FacetSizes (Q3Test entry), used by CM_ValidateFacet

inProcess.host: a CRT-free stub linked fixed at 0x400000 whose .bss spans each retail image (relocations stripped); a harness DLL copies the retail sections over that range in memory and runs them
inProcess.entry: CM_GeneratePatchCollide( width, height, points ), cdecl; patchCollide_t 40 bytes, facet_t 56 bytes, patchPlane_t 20 bytes (sizes read from the facet and plane copies, e.g. 1.08 0x40c2f0..0x40c338)
inProcess.x87ControlWord: 9001f (_control87 form: 53-bit precision, round to nearest, all exceptions masked; Windows' default for a new thread). The generator's call graph in 1.02 to 1.05 holds no control-word instruction
inProcess.fntech3Generator: code/qcommon/cm_patch.c sliced as tests/alice_patch_collision_tests.py does, game = Q3Test, compiled into the same process: HEAD e53ba098 and the change

sweep.method: docs/fntech3/2026-10-08-q3test-traces.md batteries (seed 20261008, 300 per shape); one retail run and two fnTech3 runs per map; q3tourney added for 1.06-1.08; fnTech3 servers with net_enabled 0

headServer.source: git archive of e53ba098, -Dbuild-client=false, win32-dev options

changedServer.source: the same export with this change to cm_patch.c

openDifferences.observed: the same two traces in both releases differ from retail in surfaceFlags alone (retail 1 against fnTech3 0 for player box 435, retail 0 against 1 for random box 684), before and after the change; both start in solid; fractions are bit-identical. 1.07 loads q3tourney from pak1.pk3, the same file as 1.08's (sha256 99c56e37247c...; 1.06's pak0 file is 0dd7ddbe4921...), and on it 1.08's retail server and fnTech3 both report 0 for both traces
openDifferences.inference: each trace meets a curve and a brush at the same fraction and the engines report different ones; 1.06 and 1.07 give a curve's surface flags from its shader's contents (1), 1.08 does not, so the choice shows only there. Not investigated further.

tests: tests/alice_patch_collision_tests.py: a 64-unit square standing in the x = 0 plane 10000 units out along y is dropped for Q3Test and kept for Quake III; 8000 units out both keep it; one in the x = 70000 plane is kept for Q3Test
